items.title: Louis Armstrong: Jazz Casual Interview, 1964-07-10
items.q: Yeah. Yes it was. Because I admired Jim so much. For him to send for me I thought there was something. ... when you were playing second cornet to him

ctx.x: Was it a different kind of excitement to play with this band coming up from New Orleans for you, for the inspiration? It was a big thing for me.
Yeah. Yes it was. Because I admired Jim so much. For him to send for me I thought there was something.
Now did you get, in this band, when you were playing second cornet to him, did you get to play solos all by yourself too? Oh, very subtle.
